daily7_comparison.comparative_result: Daily7 samples have persisted exact physical-sticker images plus buyer/JTBD hypothesis tied to canonical listings; the 11 shirt queries have no verified native sticker expression/JTBD bindings.
daily7_comparison.strict_limits: Different dates and selection methods, non-equivalent sample sizes; no claim of causality, relative conversion, Amazon seller success, daily demand or statistical source superiority.

diagnosis.acquisition: Rate limit 429 in all three runs; 11 related-query rows available only on the third run
diagnosis.intent: Broad shirts query family strongly mixed with brand, person, sports, media and factual garment lookups
diagnosis.triage: Conservative structural classifier cannot resolve 11 ambiguous expressions; HOLD is not evidence of negative demand
diagnosis.evidence_gap: No one new item with proven buyer segment, sticker portability and Amazon US commercial headroom
diagnosis.next_decision: Do not reenable existing broad shirt-related-query schedule. Compare any future independently supplied buyer-relevant expression lead to existing Daily7 commercial floor before authorizing new discovery acquisition.
